name: Hirosawa Rinko
source:
Born on January 16, 1980. Capricorn. Blood type is A. Her hobby is watching professional wrestling.
She is the assistant homeroom teacher for Class 3-B, assisting [url=/c129116]the protagonist[/url]. 24 years old. Serves as the English Language teacher. She supports the protagonist and is popular in the school due to her caring personality. She passed the recruitment exams through her connections, and she doesn't hold a strong passion for her job, so she's worried that being a teacher is not the right fit for her.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
